Title: Establishes the New York flight grant program
Summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to establish the New York flight grant program to offer grants to municipalities, government organizations, or community not-for-profit organizations to apply for grants to use in negotiations with airlines to attract new, direct flights and service to airports in this state; appropriates $15,000,000 therefor.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the economic development law, in relation to establishing the New York flight grant program; and making an appropriation therefor
